title: IoT rule to Amazon SNS topic to Amazon SQS queue
description: IoT Rule with a SNS action, a SNS Topic and a SQS standard Queue subscribed to the SNS topic.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern contains a sample AWS CDK stack to create an IoT Rule with a SNS action, a SNS Topic and a SQS standard Queue subscribed to the SNS topic.

When a message is published to the IoT topic defined in the IoT Rule, this message will be published to the SNS topic and then the message will be delivered to the SQS queue subscribed to the SNS topic.
